title: Implement Request Body Parsing for JSON and URL-Encoded Data
description: This feature is crucial for handling complex API requests, it enables the framework to parse JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, allowing developers to access and manipulate the data in their routes. This enhancement will improve the framework's usability and flexibility. By adding this feature, yantraverse will be more competitive with other Node.js frameworks
acceptance: The feature is accepted when the framework can successfully parse JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, and the test cases pass without errors
reason: This feature is technically justified as it fills a significant gap in the framework's functionality, and it is a common requirement for many web applications
